# Rift SDK archive

`riftlabs-plugin-sdk-0.4.48.tgz` is the actual locally packed public Rift SDK.
SHA-256: `64a9dd34e7d811bb4dbfb8cc0d846a81be45c4de9825a68a2d8e9c50b20b9d7e`.
The exact pack-time source commit was not recorded. App validation subsequently
used `edc8f6fc3d35f18ac267c6ece44ca57df4074577`; that is not exact pack provenance.
The archive includes the SDK license. The original plugin MIT license and
upstream authorship remain in LICENSE and git history.

The manifest requests exact SDK 0.4.48; the lockfile resolves it to this archive
so clean installs do not require an unpublished registry package.
